question: Can the completed local and represented semantics be frozen as one authoritative typed diagram while preserving the zero-mode, centered, comparison-only and formal-dual category boundaries?
answer: Yes. The freeze binds 17,779 authoritative rows across six distinct carrier objects: 386 local graph rows, 4,080 represented endpoint coordinates, 470 primal plus 470 action-dual residual coordinates, 30 zero-mode cotangent coordinates and 12,343 centered CE cochains. The 410 test-doublet rows and formal 8,980-coordinate cotangent comparison remain explicit exclusions. Every row is either embedded here or materializable from a content-addressed row payload and semantic template. This completes M1A, but M1B must still construct the represented composite contraction and M1C must bind all Gate-A exports and replay them on one snapshot.

scope.freeze_shape: typed diagram with distinct local, harmonic, action-dual, zero-mode and CE objects
scope.arithmetic: finite exact row materialization and SHA-256 content addressing

namespace_contract.rule: Every grading is a tagged semantic field. A grading that does not apply is serialized as NOT_APPLICABLE with a reason; it is never silently set to zero.

fields.name: bv_ghost_number
fields.meaning: standard local BV ghost number from the action-derived generator dictionary
applies_to: LOCAL_COMPONENT_JET and rows explicitly crosswalked to it

fields.name: chain_degree
fields.meaning: degree raised by the unary chain differential q1
applies_to: local and finite harmonic chain carriers

fields.name: antifield_number
applies_to: local BV rows and explicitly crosswalked harmonic rows

fields.name: form_degree
fields.meaning: spacetime differential-form degree of the local BV generator or density

fields.name: Grassmann_parity
fields.meaning: Z2 parity of the local coordinate

fields.name: mass_dimension
fields.meaning: engineering dimension in the action convention

fields.name: Weyl_weight
fields.meaning: coefficient in gamma X=Lie_xi X+w omega X

fields.name: conformal_compact_weight
fields.meaning: eigenweight of the compact conformal D grading
applies_to: zero modes and residual CE cochains

fields.name: ce_ghost_number
fields.meaning: exterior degree in the residual Chevalley-Eilenberg complex

fields.name: intrinsic_jet_order_bound
fields.meaning: maximum derivative order represented by the coordinate itself

fields.name: operator_order_bounds
fields.meaning: per-arrow differential-order metadata; never conflated with a row grading
applies_to: serialized q1, inclusion, projection, homotopy and Green names
